# A test drives a select on every target: `c.pick.change(Fruit.banana)`
# chooses the choice holding banana, whose value the `:value` binding writes
# back and the program's @change hears, once -- including where the choices are
# state that arrives after the select is built, and through an instance. The
# choices hold an enum and an int, labeled otherwise, so a value is never taken
# for a label: each control knows its choices by label, and each target's
# override of the select's @change says how it takes the label of the choice
# holding the value.
#
# gtk4 selects the label on its GtkDropDown and fyne on its Select, each of
# which reports the change as a pick does; html, bubbletea and android call
# what their control's own handler calls with a label; the interpreter's
# control holds the value itself.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

enum Fruit { apple, banana, cherry }

func named(f Fruit) => match f {
    apple => "Apple"
    banana => "Banana"
    cherry => "Cherry"
}

component chooser ui.node {
    var fruits list[Fruit] = []
    var chosen = Fruit.apple
    var picked list[Fruit] = []
    var size = 2

    ui.button #fill(text="Fill", @click { fruits = [Fruit.apple, Fruit.banana, Fruit.cherry] })
    ui.select #pick(:value=chosen, @change(v) { picked.push(v) }) {
        for var f = fruits {
            ui.choice(label=named(f), value=f)
        }
    }
    ui.select #sizes(:value=size) {
        ui.choice(label="Small", value=1)
        ui.choice(label="Medium", value=2)
        ui.choice(label="Large", value=3)
    }
    ui.text(value="{chosen} {size}")
}

component wrapped ui.node {
    chooser #inner()
}

func testChangePicksTheChoiceHolding(t test.Test, c chooser) {
    c.fill.click()
    c.pick.change(Fruit.banana)
    t.assert(c.chosen == Fruit.banana)
    t.assert(c.picked.length() == 1 && c.picked[0] == Fruit.banana)
}

func testChangePicksAnInt(t test.Test, c chooser) {
    c.sizes.change(3)
    t.assert(c.size == 3)
}

func testChangeReachesThroughAnInstance(t test.Test, c wrapped) {
    c.inner.fill.click()
    c.inner.pick.change(Fruit.cherry)
    t.assert(c.inner.chosen == Fruit.cherry)
}
